models.name: Fixed-Scope Project
models.idealFor: Clearly defined projects, MVPs, proof-of-concepts, and scoped feature additions.
models.description: We define comprehensive requirements, deliverables, milestones, and acceptance criteria upfront. Best for projects with stable, well-understood boundaries.
keyCharacteristics: Clear upfront budget with no surprise costs
Explicit acceptance criteria and sign-off points
Warranty period for defect remediation following release

models.name: Discovery & Technical Assessment
models.idealFor: Organizations planning new software initiatives or evaluating AI feasibility before committing major capital.
models.description: A focused, time-boxed technical investigation (typically 1 to 2 weeks) analyzing architecture, data readiness, security risks, and feasibility.
keyCharacteristics: In-depth interviews with business and engineering stakeholders
Concrete architectural assessment report and risk matrix
Actionable roadmap with realistic budget and effort estimates

models.name: Ongoing Maintenance & Engineering Retainer
models.idealFor: Businesses with existing software applications requiring reliable ongoing upkeep, bug fixes, updates, and optimization.
models.description: A monthly engagement providing dedicated engineering hours for bug fixing, library upgrades, database optimization, code refactoring, and technical debt reduction.
keyCharacteristics: Agreed monthly hours and service windows
Prioritized backlog triage and monthly release cycles
Continuous security patching and dependency maintenance
Transparent time and activity tracking reports

models.name: Institutional College Partnership
models.idealFor: Engineering colleges seeking tailored student assessments, company simulations, and technical workshops.
models.description: Collaborative engagement calibrated to institutional schedules, student batch numbers, engineering branches, and specific placement timelines.
keyCharacteristics: Tailored cohort sizing from single branches to campus-wide drives
Detailed diagnostic reporting delivered to college leadership & TPOs
Combination of human-led assessments, simulations, and workshops
Clear scheduling around semester exams and recruitment seasons
